subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite to the face showing ‘6’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d70db7a31f917571f63df05700a5d959be2cd38a4d77633b0c4240c2c639a6.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different dices the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 5 is common on both the dice I and III, it is clear that 1, 3, 4, and 6 are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. 2 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e726a867d49dcc1097b3d7afa66bc349876ac37a43bff246d27a88750bd7fc0.png] 

Opposite pairs:

1 → 4

3 → 6

5 → 2

So, the opposite side of "6" will be side "3".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
